entities.name: Authentication procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure for authenticating the UE and establishing security context.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE containing authentication challenge parameters.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network containing authentication response result.

entities.name: RAND
entities.description: Random challenge value used in authentication procedure.

entities.name: AUTN
entities.description: Authentication token used for network authentication.

entities.name: RES
entities.description: Authentication response parameter containing UE's computed result.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED initiated
entities.description: UE state when authentication procedure is initiated during registration.

relations.description: Authentication procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
Authentication procedure includes receiving AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains RAND parameter
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains AUTN parameter
AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains RES parameter
Authentication procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED initiated state
